entries.title: Job 1:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The holiness, riches, and religious care of Job for his children. 6 Satan, appearing before God, by calumniation obtains leave to afflict Job. 13 Understanding of the loss of his children and goods, in his mourning he blesses God.

Uz. Ge 10:23; 22:20,21 Huz. Ge 36:28; 1Ch 1:17,42; Jer 25:20; La 4:21 Job. Eze 14:14,20; Jas 5:11 perfect. 8; 2:3; 23:11,12; 31:1-40; Ge 6:9; 17:1; 2Ki 20:3; 2Ch 31:20,21 Lu 1:6 one. Ge 22:12; Pr 8:13; 16:6; 1Pe 3:11

entries.title: Job 1:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: substance. or, cattle. Ge 12:5; 13:6; 34:23; 2Ch 32:29 seven. 42:12; Ge 12:16; Nu 31:32-34; Jud 6:5; 1Sa 25:2; 2Ki 3:4; Pr 10:22 household. or, husbandry. 2Ch 26:10 greatest. 29:9,10,25 men. Heb. sons. Jud 6:3; 7:12; 8:10; 1Ki 4:30 of the east. Ge 25:6; 29:1; Nu 23:7

entries.title: Job 1:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: sent and called. Ps 133:1; Heb 13:1

entries.title: Job 1:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: sanctified. 41:25; Ge 35:2,3; Ex 19:10; 1Sa 16:5; Ne 12:30; Joh 11:55 rose up. Ge 22:3; Ps 5:3; Ec 9:10 offered. 42:8; Ge 8:20; Ex 18:12; 24:5; Le 1:3-6 according. 1Ki 18:31; Ac 21:26 It may be. 2Co 11:2 cursed. 11; 2:9; Le 24:10-16; 1Ki 21:10,13 in their hearts. Ge 6:5; Jer 4:14; 17:9,10; Mr 7:21-23; Ac 8:22; 1Co 4:5 Thus. 27:10 continually. Heb. all the days. Lu 1:75; 18:7; Eph 6:18

entries.title: Job 1:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Now. 2:1 the sons. 38:7; Da 3:25; Lu 3:38 came to. Ps 103:20; Mt 18:10 Satan. Heb. the adversary. 1Ki 22:19; 1Ch 21:1; Zec 3:1; Re 12:9,10 came also. Joh 6:70 among them. Heb. in the midst of them.

entries.title: Job 1:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: considered. Heb. set thy heart on. 2:3; 34:14; Eze 40:4 my servant. Nu 12:7,8; Ps 89:20; Isa 42:1 none. Nu 12:3; 1Ki 4:30,31; 2Ki 23:25 a perfect. 1; 8:20; 9:22,23; Ps 18:23; Joh 1:47 upright. 12:4; 17:8,9; 23:11,12; Ps 84:11 one. Ne 5:15; Ps 36:1; Pr 8:13; Lu 23:39,40 escheweth. Ps 34:14; 37:27; Isa 1:16

entries.title: Job 1:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: But put. 12; 2:5; Isa 5:25 touch. 4:5; 19:21; Ge 26:11; Ps 105:15; Zec 2:8 and he will curse thee. Heb. if he curse thee not. 5,21; 2:9; Isa 8:21; Mal 3:13,14; Re 16:9,11,21

entries.title: Job 1:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: messenger. 1Sa 4:17; 2Sa 15:13; Jer 51:31

entries.title: Job 1:16
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: there came. Ge 19:24; Le 9:24; 1Ki 18:38; 2Ki 1:10,12,14; Am 7:4; Re 13:13 The fire of God. or, A great fire. Ex 9:28; 1Sa 14:15; *marg:

entries.title: Job 1:17
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: The Chaldeans. Ge 11:28; Isa 23:13; Hab 1:6 fell. Heb. rushed. I only am. 15; 2Sa 1:3

entries.title: Job 1:19
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: a great. Jer 4:11,12; Eph 2:2 from. Heb. from aside, etc. it fell. Jud 16:30; 1Ki 20:30; Mt 7:27; Lu 13:1-5; Ac 28:4 they are dead. Ge 37:32,33; 42:36; 2Sa 18:33

entries.title: Job 1:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: rent. Ge 37:29,34; Ezr 9:3 mantle. or robe. fell. De 9:18; 2Sa 12:16-20; 2Ch 7:3; Mt 26:39; 1Pe 5:6

entries.title: Job 1:22
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: In all this. 2:10; Jas 1:4,12; 1Pe 1:7 charged God foolishly. or, attributed folly to God. 34:10,18,19; 40:4-8; Ro 9:20
